'''Alex Reese''' (born May 21, 1999)<ref>{{cite web|title=Alex Reese – College Stats|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/alex-reese-1.html|website=Sports-Reference.com|access-date=September 29, 2024}}</ref> is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Körfez Basket]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama Crimson Tide]], and appeared in 15 [[NBA]] games.

==High school career==
Reese attended [[Pelham High School (Alabama)|Pelham High School]] in [[Pelham, Alabama]] where he averaged a double-double in each season, including 25.4 points, 10.9 rebounds and 2 blocks per game as a junior, helping the Panthers reach the Sweet 16 as a junior and the Elite Eight during his senior season after the program had only once reached the Sweet 16 previously.<ref name="Simonson2024">{{cite web|first=Andrew|last=Simonson|title=Pelham native, Alabama alum Alex Reese joins Oklahoma City Thunder on Exhibit 10 deal|url=https://www.shelbycountyreporter.com/2024/09/28/pelham-native-alabama-alum-alex-reese-joins-oklahoma-city-thunder-on-exhibit-10-deal/|website=ShelbyCountyReporter.com|date=September 28, 2024|access-date=September 29, 2024}}</ref> For that, he was named the 6A Player of the Year and to the Alabama All-Star Team as a senior and was a two-time All-State First Team selection. He also was a two-time Shelby County Player of the Year, sharing the award as a junior and winning it outright as a senior.<ref name="Simonson2024" /><ref name="AlabamaBio">{{cite web|title=Alex Reese – 2019–20  Men's Basketball Roster|url=https://rolltide.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/alex-reese/6830|website=RollTide.com|access-date=September 29, 2024}}</ref>

==College career==
Reese attended [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama]] where he played four years and appeared in 124 games, starting 36,<ref name="KPTV2023">{{cite web|title=Rip City Remix acquire Alabama alum Alex Reese|url=https://www.kptv.com/2023/11/13/rip-city-remix-acquire-alabama-alum-alex-reese/|website=KPTV.com|date=November 13, 2023|access-date=September 29, 2024}}</ref> while averaging 5.4 points and 3.1 rebounds on .369/.282/.706 shooting splits as a senior.<ref name="AlabamaBio" /><ref>{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Thunder, Alex Reese Agree To Exhibit 10 Deal|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/09/thunder-alex-reese-agree-to-exhibit-10-deal.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=September 27, 2024|access-date=September 29, 2024}}</ref>

==Professional career==
After going undrafted in the 2021, Reese spent a year away from the game working as a bartender and moving furniture,<ref>{{cite tweet|first=Andrew|last=Schlecht|title=New Thunder signee Alex Reese took some time away from basketball 3 years ago. He was a bartender and moved furniture… that helped him rediscover his love of the game Now he’s the 15th man on the Thunder|number=1847986860909293665|user=AndrewKSchlecht|date=October 20, 2024|access-date=October 22, 2024}}</ref> before signing with [[B.B.C. Amicale Steesel|Amicale Steesel]] of the [[Luxembourg Basketball League]] on July 26, 2022.<ref>{{cite web|title=Amicale Steinsel tabs Alex Reese|url=https://www.interperformances.com/news/amicale-steinsel-tabs-alex-reese/|website=InterPerformances.com|date=July 26, 2022|access-date=September 29, 2024}}</ref> In 27 games, he averaged 23.7 points, 12.9 rebounds, 1.4 assists, 1.0 steals and 1.5 blocks in 33.1 minutes.<ref name="KPTV2023" />

On October 30, 2023, Reese joined the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]] after a tryout,<ref>{{cite web|title=VIPERS FINALIZE TRAINING CAMP ROSTER|url=https://riograndevalley.gleague.nba.com/news/vipers-finalize-training-cambp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 30, 2023|access-date=September 29, 2024}}</ref> but was waived on November 8.<ref>{{cite web|title=2023-2024 Rio Grande Valley Vipers Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Rio-Grande-Valley-Vipers/14/Transaction_History/2024|website=RealGM.com|access-date=September 29, 2024}}</ref> He was later claimed off waivers by the [[Rip City Remix]]<ref>{{cite tweet|first=Sean|last=Highkin|title=The Rip City Remix have claimed F/C Alex Reese off waivers from the Rio Grande Valley Vipers. Reese made the Vipers from a public tryout after previously playing professionally in Luxembourg. He played four years in college at Alabama from 2017-21.|number=1724145106729734350|user=highkin|date=November 13, 2023|access-date=September 29, 2024}}</ref> where he played in 43 games and averaged 11.5 points, 4.6 rebounds and 1.2 blocks in 17.2 minutes.<ref>{{cite web|title=Alex Reese Player Profile|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Alex-Reese/Summary/97091|website=RealGM.com|access-date=September 29, 2024}}</ref>

After joining the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] for the [[2024 NBA Summer League]],<ref>{{cite web|title=TRAIL BLAZERS ANNOUNCE NBA 2K25 SUMMER LEAGUE 2024 ROSTER|url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-announce-nba-2k25-summer-league-2024-roster|website=NBA.com|date=July 5, 2024|access-date=September 29, 2024}}</ref> Reese signed with the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] on September 27, 2024,<ref>{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Thunder Sign Cormac Ryan, Two Others|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/09/thunder-sign-cormac-ryan-two-others.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=September 27, 2024|access-date=September 29, 2024}}</ref><ref name="Simonson2024" /> but was waived on October 16.<ref>{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Thunder Sign Buddy Boeheim, Cut Alex Reese|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/10/thunder-sign-buddy-boeheim-cut-alex-reese.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 16, 2024|access-date=October 18, 2024}}</ref> Three days later, he re-signed with the Thunder,<ref>{{cite web|title=Thunder Signs Alex Reese|url=https://www.nba.com/thunder/news/release-reese-241019|website=NBA.com|date=October 19, 2024|access-date=October 19, 2024}}</ref> but was waived on October 31 after playing in one game.<ref>{{cite web|title=Thunder Signs Malevy Leons|url=https://www.nba.com/thunder/news/thunder-signs-malevy-leons|website=NBA.com|date=October 31, 2024|access-date=October 31, 2024}}</ref>

On November 3, 2024, Reese returned to the [[Rip City Remix]].<ref>{{cite tweet|author=Kenny’s G League|title=The Rip City Remix have acquired Alex Reese. Reese was a key player during the Remix’s inaugural season and most recently played for the Oklahoma City Thunder.|number=1853499414591271190|user=KennysGLeague|date=November 4, 2024|access-date=November 4, 2024}}</ref>

On February 20, 2025, Reese signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Philadelphia 76ers]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Carlin |first=Ky |title=Report: Sixers to sign former Thunder F Alex Reese to a two-way deal |url=https://sixerswire.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/sixers/2025/02/20/report-sixers-to-sign-former-thunder-f-alex-reese-to-a-two-way-deal/79317115007/ |access-date=2025-02-20 |website=Sixers Wire |language=en-US}}</ref> He made 14 appearances for Philadelphia, averaging 5.3 points, 3.3 rebounds, and 0.3 assists. Reese was waived by the 76ers following the signing of [[Dominick Barlow]] on July 9.<ref>{{cite web | last1=Miller | first1=Will | last2=De Siver | first2=Hunter | title=Report: Philadelphia 76ers Waiving Former Alabama Player Alex Reese | website=Alabama Crimson Tide On SI | date=2025-07-09 | url=https://www.si.com/college/alabama/basketball/report-philadelphia-76ers-waiving-former-alabama-player-alex-reese | access-date=2025-12-05}}</ref>

For the [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025–26 season]], Reese re-joined the Remix.

On August 9, 2026, he signed with [[Körfez Basket]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).<ref>{{Cite tweet |user=glintkorfez |number=2086470786991198309 |title=Alex Reese, Glint Körfez Basket’te! }}</ref>
